title: Unit 5 · m
description: 15 câu · monkey · milk · money · mouse · Nghe, nhìn tranh, phân loại, xếp thứ tự, nối cặp.

items.title: Unit 5 · m
items.prompt: Listen and choose the correct picture.
items.spokenPrompt: Listen and choose the correct picture.
items.hint: Listen again. Look carefully, then choose.
items.why: Titi said “monkey”. Match the whole spoken word to its picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 1 · Unit 5 · centre practice

items.title: Unit 5 · m
items.prompt: Look at the picture. Choose the correct word.
items.spokenPrompt: Look at the picture. Choose the correct word.
items.hint: Listen again. Look carefully, then choose.
items.why: This picture shows “milk”. Read every letter, including the ending.

items.title: Unit 5 · m
items.prompt: Which word begins with letter M?
items.spokenScene: Which word begins with letter M?
items.hint: Listen again. Look carefully, then choose.
items.why: “money” begins with letter M. Compare the first letter of each word.

items.title: Unit 5 · m
items.scene: Listen, then put the cards in order.
items.prompt: Tap the words in the order you hear them.
items.spokenPrompt: Tap the words in the order you hear them.
items.hint: Listen to the first word, then the second and third. Tap a placed card to undo it.
items.why: The spoken order is: monkey, milk, money.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 1 · Unit 5 · centre practice

items.title: Unit 5 · m

items.hint: Choose a word on the left, then its picture on the right. You can change a pair before checking.
